_meta.description: Feature usage manifest — categorizes Deckent features by activity level based on code analysis and sprint history. Categories: active (used every sprint), lightly_used (exists but infrequent), dormant (implemented but not wired into sprint lifecycle), dead (deprecated/superseded).

sourceAnalysis.methodology: import-graph traversal + grep frequency + @deprecated markers + sprint log review

active.label: Sprint Controller — Core Orchestrator
active.description: Central orchestrator for PLAN→SPAWN→EXECUTE→EVALUATE→FIX→RETRO→DECAY→CLEANUP lifecycle. Used every sprint.

active.label: Task Builder — Worker Prompt Builder + Directive Parser
active.description: Builds worker prompts (ADR injection Sprint 138), parses DIRECTIVES scope/model/effort/skills/agent overrides. Called by brain every sprint during PLAN phase.

active.label: Result Evaluator — GO/NO-GO/TECH_DEBT Decision Engine
active.description: Evaluates task results with rubric scoring, CODE_VERIFIED_DONE logic, and TECH_DEBT downgrade. Central to EVALUATE phase. Used every sprint.

active.label: Auditor — 30s Scan Loop + 3-Pipeline Verification
active.description: In-process auditor: scans heartbeats, git diff boundary violations, stale locks, verifyWorkerResult 3-pipeline (Sprint 138), ADR compliance checks, authority matrix enforcement (Sprint 139 T-035).

active.label: Tmux Backend — Worker Spawn via tmux Sessions
active.description: Default worker spawn backend using tmux sessions. Used in all sprints unless docker/subprocess backend explicitly configured.

active.label: Docker Backend — Container-Based Worker Isolation
active.description: Docker container-based worker spawn backend. Sprint 139 target backend for CI pipeline and isolation. E2E tested in Sprint 135 (graceful shutdown) and Sprint 139 (T-017 backend parity).

active.label: Subprocess Backend — Direct Process Worker Spawn
active.description: Non-tmux subprocess backend for environments without tmux. Sprint 139 T-019 confirmed 33 E2E tests, 1.2s runtime.

active.label: Brain FIX Phase — Failed Task Retry Orchestration
active.description: Retries NO_GO tasks in FIX phase with cross-dependency priority. Wired in sprint-phases.ts runFixPhase(). Used whenever a sprint has NO_GO tasks.

active.label: Dependency Scheduler — Topological Wave Ordering
active.description: DependencyGraph with Kahn's algorithm for sprint task wave ordering. Sprint 139 T-028/T-029/T-030. Supersedes ParallelPipelineManager for dependency resolution. Called by sprint-spawner enforceWaveDependency() every sprint cycle.

active.label: Event Stream — ADR-035 Structured Event Log
active.description: Append-only .deckent/sprint-NNN-events.jsonl event log. Protocol V1.0 with 15 channel codes. Primary communication channel Brain↔Worker↔Auditor (Sprint 138 T-004). Integrated with authority-enforcer, dependency-scheduler, auditor.

active.label: Sprint Checkpoint — Resume Capability (Sprint 138 MVP)
active.description: Writes checkpoint every N=5 tasks. Resume command restores sprint state. Sprint 138 T-009 MVP. Wired into sprint-spawner (writes checkpoint on task completion).

active.label: Routing Engine V2 — Intent-Based Task Router
active.description: V2 intent-based routing: routeTaskV2(), confidence scoring, agent/skill/provider assignment. Used every sprint via task-router.ts.

active.label: Sprint Retrospective + Reporter
active.description: Writes RETRO.md, MEMORY.md sprint learnings, 7-section rich sprint output, token usage section. Called in RETRO phase every sprint.

active.label: Authority Enforcer — ADR-037 RBAC Runtime Enforcement
active.description: Runtime RBAC authority matrix enforcement (Sprint 139 T-035). Checks file-system path and event-stream channel permissions per role (brain/auditor/worker). Soft enforcement mode (Sprint 139). Integrated with auditor.ts runAuthorityChecks().

active.label: Model Registry — 13 Models, 3 Providers, Tier Routing
active.description: Single source of truth for model tiers (premium_plus/premium/standard/economy). Provider-agnostic routing. Used by task-router.ts every sprint.

lightly_used.label: Archive Debt — CLI Debt Rotation Command
lightly_used.description: CLI-only command (no MCP equivalent — ADR-022 parity gap). Rotates resolved DEBT.md entries to archive. Rarely called — only when debt table grows large.

lightly_used.label: Skill Marketplace — Skill Discovery + Installation
lightly_used.description: Sub-command of 'deckent skill'. Lists/installs skills from marketplace. CLI-only. Infrequently used — mostly during project setup or skill exploration.

lightly_used.label: Managed Docs — Sprint Lifecycle Doc Auto-Update
lightly_used.description: ADR-029 template-based doc generation. Updates user-configured markdown docs after each sprint. Requires .deckent/docs.json to be configured — opt-in. Only active in projects with docs.json.
lightly_used.parityGap: opt-in, many projects never configure it

lightly_used.label: Agent/Skill Evolution Pipeline — Promotion/Demotion
lightly_used.description: Evaluates temp agents/skills for promotion to permanent pool. Called in sprint-finalizer evaluatePromotions(). Temp skill generation in sprint-planner. Active but rarely triggers promotions in practice.

lightly_used.label: MCP/CLI Parity Gaps — CLI-Only Commands
lightly_used.description: ADR-022: CLI commands without MCP equivalents. Infrastructure/UI commands (attach, spawn, watch, dashboard, web, serve) are intentionally CLI-only. Setup commands (upgrade, onboard) also CLI-only. test-run, finalize, quick-start infrequently used.

lightly_used.label: Rollback — Sprint Rollback on All-NO_GO
lightly_used.description: Triggered only when all sprint tasks are NO_GO and rollback_policy is configured. Rarely activates in practice. Config-gated feature.

dormant.label: Heartbeat Daemon — Background Proactive Heartbeat Tasks
dormant.description: CLI command 'deckent heartbeat' runs HEARTBEAT.md tasks on interval. HeartbeatDaemon class implemented. NOT wired into sprint-controller — requires manual deckent heartbeat invocation. No auto-start in sprint lifecycle.

dormant.label: Human Checkpoint — Sprint Pause for Human Approval
dormant.description: Sprint 135 checkpoint approval system. Pause sprint and wait for human deckent checkpoint approve/reject. Partially wired in sprint-lifecycle waitForHumanApproval(). Not configured by default — requires CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL to be set.

dormant.label: Shared Memory — Cross-Worker In-Memory Context
dormant.description: SharedMemory class for cross-worker data sharing within a sprint. Zero external imports outside its own file. Not wired into sprint worker spawn or task execution pipeline.
dormant.blockedBy: no integration point in worker prompt or spawn

dormant.label: Handoff Protocol — Worker State Handoff
dormant.description: Worker state handoff protocol for task transfer between workers. Zero external imports. Not connected to sprint lifecycle.

dormant.label: Multi-Agent Pipeline — Collaborative Task Execution
dormant.description: MultiAgentPipeline class for coordinated multi-agent task execution with shared context. Only referenced in its own file (internal usage) and agent-types.ts interface. Not connected to sprint-controller task dispatch.

dormant.label: Ecosystem Intelligence — Skill Activation Persistence
dormant.description: analyzeNewSkill + persistSkillActivation called from CLI 'deckent skill add' workflow. Lightly connected but ecosystem analysis not used in sprint planning or routing decisions.
dormant.blockedBy: analysis output not consumed by routing-engine-v2

dead.label: Decision Orchestrator V1 — Keyword-Based Routing (Deprecated)
dead.description: Sprint 031 V1 keyword-based routing. Explicitly @deprecated since Sprint 066. NOT used in production sprint execution — comment in source: 'DecisionOrchestrator is only used by test suites'. Superseded by routeTaskV2() intent-based engine (ADR-028). decision-logger.ts still consumed by V2 for logging.
dead.note: 4 source files + 38 tests maintained as reference implementation per ADR-028. decision-logger.ts retained for V2 logging.

dead.label: ParallelPipelineManager — Legacy Wave Builder (Superseded)
dead.description: Original topological wave builder. Still imported by sprint-spawner.ts for validateTaskDependencies() wrapper function. Core DependencyCycleError class still used. However, primary dependency/wave logic superseded by dependency-scheduler.ts (Sprint 139 T-028/T-029/T-030) which uses Kahn's algorithm with collision-awareness and event stream integration.
dead.note: DependencyCycleError and validateTaskDependencies() still in use as thin wrappers. Full parallel pipeline execution path dead — new code uses dependency-scheduler directly.
